notes.title: May 22 Updat
notes.content:
1.Artifact Purchase Feature Addition
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/554d0a0faf7d71d7c1092d672fd21968bcac94a8.png

-When embarking on the Eclipse Realm, you can purchase up to two artifacts.
-Purchased artifacts will be automatically acquired at the start of the session.
-Purchasing artifacts will consume a certain amount of currency, and embarking will be impossible if the currency is insufficient.
-Some legendary artifacts have been excluded from the purchase list.

2.Artifact Modifications
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/2b1910435f6fd1c7ec84cbef8230469389137a69.png

-The cooldown reduction of the Worn Necklace of Swiftness has been adjusted from 1 second to 0.5 seconds.

notes.title: Updated April 29
notes.content:
1. New character Weave added
-New character Weave is added.
-Weave is an artificial life form made up of powerful artifacts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/82716046d8f01cc507a14dd26c28080041e10496.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/1a86deed9577bac25ba7a54c15cbd3dc1408e1f0.jpg


-Leader Ability
-At the start of the battle, obtain the Compass of Destruction, a Weave-exclusive artifact.
-The Compass of Destruction is an artifact that grows into various forms through artifact selection.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/66c9f81a124a5e3a555e85300b4ffc36985c6e0c.jpg


-Leader skills
-Longinus, a long-distance skill, flies in the direction of the mouse cursor and deals powerful damage.
-Darkmoral, an area skill, deals damage by creating multiple spheres of darkness that inflict continuous damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/10c73c827208c67e383407c7457af8b9a0ddd090.jpg

-Skill
-A total of five skills have been added, including the basic skill.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/3704c60734a2617dd84fd6c4c3565d674887ddee.jpg

2. Add risk field
-The land consumed by darkness, the territory of Baras, the King of Death, has been added as a risk map.
-The higher the risk level of the land consumed by darkness, the more rewards and rank points you can obtain, and the higher the risk level, the more powerful the monsters.
-The current risk level consists of 40 levels, and as the risk level increases, monsters appear or are added and become more strengthened.
-To open the land engulfed in darkness, you must clear Awakened Threat one additional time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/7e4fb7b3a4dbe4ef0723415c3099d3925d765aa5.png

3. Offline mode support
-The build will be modified to allow solo play even in Steam's offline mode.
-In offline mode, all content except cooperative play and play together operates.


4. Cooperative play map balance modifications
-The balance of cooperative play will be adjusted as the character grows.


5. Reset rank score
-Rank scores will be reset to modify offline mode and cooperative play.


6. Synergy skill information output 
-You can check the synergy skills of characters at the Fallen Angel office. 
-Synergy skills are skills that appear when participating in battle with a specific character.

notes.title: March 14 update
notes.content:
1. Game pad support
-In the game settings, the auto targeting option is added to automatically look at the enemies of the game pad, vibration intensity and in -game play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/c63e2d3a85e5122e260d758f3c24f76d2ef27fcf.png

-The current auto targeting does not apply to skills to the mouse point. (EX giant baby, carpet bombing, etc.)
-I will improve auto targeting later to provide an option for Trinity Survivors.
-Customization of the game pad will also be provided later through the update.

2. Add a single stage difficulty function
-You can adjust the difficulty level of the stage on the screening screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/3df9112aebcc2c257c12392c6af879c38a3e4a16.png

-The difficulty level controls the attack power of the monster, the frequency of attack and the speed of movement.
-The higher the difficulty, the higher the goods and the final score, and the lower the difficulty, the lower the goods and the score.
-The initial rewards and unlocks proceed regardless of difficulty.
-The difficulty appears from 4 stages and is composed of 4 stages except for the final stage, the final stage. (Easy, normal, Hard, very Hard)
-The final stage, Awakened threat, offers five difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, Hell.

3. Have a single stage with friends (BETA)
-The ability to join a single stage with friends has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/11090dfd9eb269c4fca5ef29f449d3fcc2689dfe.png

-The BETA version is a new mode of multiplayer to invite Steam friends to clear the stage together.
-It can be proceeded from stage 4 to be with friends.
-The balance is automatically adjusted according to the growth difference, and the initial reward and release are performed normally even when cleared by two -person cooperation.
-There is no separate life gauge like a cooperative war, but the resurrection function is set to operate normal when death.
-When the level up and artifact is obtained, the game will be suspended for a certain period of time, and when everyone finishes the choice, the game will be resumed again.

4. Add 12 species of synergy skill growth
-There are 12 synergy skills that appear when certain characters came together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/4514d32df610307371d91931cbd35a6fa5e18c1d.png

Synergy skills are composed of skills that have a powerful additional effect.
-There are two synergy skill growth per character, and the update will add a variety of additional effects and new synergy skills.

5. Improved blood kill reward method
-The method in which existing usable and unusable artifacts appear with a certain probability when obtaining a Blood Kill reward box will be modified.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809605/5bf75b267bcb17549e60758f86e2388f5947d5e2.png

-Usability artifacts appear first when receiving Blood Kill rewards, but you can replace them with regular artifacts by pressing the Replace with Unusable Artifacts button below.
-You can obtain it by selecting usability or non-usability depending on the situation.
-When resetting an artifact, only the currently selected artifact is reset.

6. Add new artifacts
-fruit of awakening (Rare): It appears without any unlock conditions, and drops a Legendary Growth Scroll when acquired.
-Parchment of Deep Thousht (common): It appears without any unlock conditions and provides 15% additional experience gain and 3 level-up resets.

7. Artifact modifications
-Ancient parchment (common): The amount of experience gained is changed from 30% to 15%.
-Isrelda's blessing: Stamina recovery per 1 blood kill (1 second cooldown) is changed from 3 recovery per blood kill (cool time 2 seconds).
-Blessing of the Forest Goddess: 20% reduction in damage is added. Make the character invincible for 5 seconds every 30 seconds.

8. Tana's blacksmith price modification
-The purchase price of legendary artifacts will be modified from 50000 gold to 20000 gold.

9. Fixed tactical training costs
-The cost of secondary tactical training is changed from 5000 gold and 2000 crystals to 3000 gold and 1000 crystals.

notes.title: March 5 update
notes.content:
1. Change of skill training cost payment method
-It is changed by selecting the skills you want and purchasing at a fixed amount of skill training in the existing Gacha skill training.
-The cost is a common 20 bloodstone, a Uncommon 30 bloodstone and a rare 40 bloodstones.

2. Artifact modification
-Enhanced Throwing Knife: The number of daggers increases to eight and the size is reduced.
-Glass Cannon: Modified from 30% to 25% critical damage. Modified from 70% to 50% of the critical damage when it is 30% or less
-Enhanced Glass Cannon: Modified from 30% to 25% critical damage. Modified from 70% to 50% of the critical damage when it is 50% or less
-Berserker's Belt: When you have more than 30% of your health, you modify it from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
-Enhanced Berserker's Belt: When you have more than 40% of your health, you modify it from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
-Bloody Pendant: Bloodkill occurrence conditions 30 to 20 times modified
-Enhanced Bloody Pendant: Bloodkill occurrence conditions 30 to 20 times modified

3. Stage:Tainted Forest modification
-Fix the spawn distance of the GoblinSniper not to be too far away

4. Effect modification
-The visibility of some of the effects of the character and monster has been enhanced.

notes.title: Hello, this is the Trinity Survivors development team.
notes.content:
Upcoming Update Directions Shared 

1. Game Controller Support 
- The development team is prioritizing official support for controllers as a top priority. 

2. Skill Training Cost Method Revision 
- Instead of the existing gacha system, it will be revised to allow choosing desired skills by paying a fixed cost. 

3. New Artifacts 
- About 20 new artifacts are planned to be added. 
- Among the new artifacts, character-specific artifacts will appear according to the characters deployed, offering higher efficiency than general artifacts. 
- The new artifacts are expected to be available for purchase at Tana's Forge. 

4. Clearing Single Stages with Friends 
- An update is planned to allow clearing single stages together with friends by forming a party. 
- Balance adjustments will be made according to the growth differences, and stages not cleared by oneself cannot be played together. 
- Clearing will process the first rewards and unlocking, but will not be recorded on the ranking board. 
- Further details will be shared in the future. 



The development team has received a lot of feedback and is committed to providing a better build with utmost effort.

notes.title: Maintenance Server and Contents update.
notes.content:
"Hello everyone,

Maintenance will begin shortly.
It is expected to take about 10 minutes.

Details of the update will be shared with you later.

Thank you."

notes.title: Hello, this is the Trinity Survivors development team.
notes.content:
Hello users.
We will share the development team's update direction.

1. We are trying to allow users to play the game through the controller as soon as possible.

2. Multiplay
- We have confirmed that the attack power of the "Watcher" is abnormal.
- Fixes the massive balance and level design of cooperative play, including the "Watcher" modification.
- Multiplay will be reset the ranking and provides a new level.

3. Tactical training
-The secondary growth is being prepared for tactical training.
-The secondary growth will increase the speed of leadership skills, the growth of usable artifacts, and the growth by skill type.

4. Personal training center-> skill training
-The skills will be printed for each character to learn by skill training. (Skill cards are different for each character.)

5. Fix Bug
-It will fix the warning range of some skills of sand.
-It will fix some UI output.

6. Colorblind Mode
-If you can't see the enemy's attack, check the colorblind mode of the settings.

Have a fun game.
thank you

notes.title: Hello, this is the Trinity Survivors development team.
notes.content:
Hello users.
We would like to share the development team's update direction.

1. We plan to make it possible for users to experience multiplayer play faster and enjoy cooperative play in the early stages. However, please note that the current balance may be difficult to enjoy in the early stages.

2. Currently, some pad usage is possible in gameplay, but it is not perfect. We will strive to make it possible to enjoy the game quickly through the pad.

3. We are considering feedback on speed play. We will try to provide an answer soon.

Have a great game.
Thank you.
February 02, 2024.
